title: Syntheses, structures and magnetic properties of two Dy6 clusters based on polydentate ligands with a new topological motif

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear Dy6 cluster with a central butterfly Dy4 unit and two peripheral Dy ions; topology 1,3,3M6-1

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution (5 mL) of DyCl3·6H2O (37 mg, 0.01 mmol) and CoCl2·6H2O (23 mg, 0.01 mmol) was placed at the bottom of a test tube. Acetonitrile (8 mL) was rapidly added as a buffering solvent, and a freshly prepared methanol solution (2 mL) of H2ppo (24 mg, 0.01 mmol) and NEt3 (28 μL) was layered on top. The main text describes the analogous layering below 10 °C. Yellow rod-like crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained in 4 weeks. Yield: 13% based on H2ppo. CoCl2 is required for crystallization but is not incorporated into the product.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow rod-like crystals formed directly by slow layering and were used for X-ray diffraction.

properties.summary: Complex 1 shows an overall ferromagnetic interaction and slow magnetization relaxation characteristic of SMM behavior. χMT falls from 83.77 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature to a minimum of 70.26 cm3 K mol−1 at 18 K, then rises to 75.84 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 41.72 μB at 7 T, below the 60 μB saturation expected for six Dy(III) ions. Zero-field ac data lack frequency-dependent χ″ peaks because of fast quantum tunneling; a Debye fit gives τ0 = 8.55×10−5 s and Ea = 1.33 K. Under 0.3 T, χ′ and χ″ maxima appear and quantum tunneling is suppressed.

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear Dy6 cluster with a central butterfly Dy4 unit and two peripheral Dy ions; topology 1,3,3M6-1

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution (5 mL) of DyCl3·6H2O (37 mg, 0.01 mmol) and CoCl2·6H2O (23 mg, 0.01 mmol) was placed at the bottom of a test tube. Acetonitrile (8 mL) was rapidly added as a buffering solvent, and a freshly prepared methanol solution (2 mL) of H2Meppo (26 mg, 0.01 mmol) and NEt3 (28 μL) was layered on top. The main text describes the analogous layering below 10 °C. Yellow sheet-like crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained in 3 weeks. Yield: 21% based on H2Meppo. The SI synthesis text writes two lattice MeCN molecules, but Table S1 and CCDC formula C164H142Dy6O36·2(MeOH) contain no nitrogen, so the crystallographic formula is used. CoCl2 is required for crystallization but is not incorporated.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow sheet-like crystals formed directly by slow layering and were used for X-ray diffraction.

properties.summary: Complex 2 shows ferromagnetic coupling and SMM-like slow relaxation. χMT is 84.01 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature, nearly constant to 180 K, falls to 72.12 cm3 K mol−1 at 7 K, then rises to 74.00 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 34.84 μB at 7 T, below the 60 μB expected for six Dy(III) ions, and 2 is harder to magnetize than 1. A Debye fit of zero-field ac data gives τ0 = 1.73×10−5 s and Ea = 2.89 K. Frequency-dependent χ′ and χ″ maxima appear under 0.3 T, consistent with suppression of quantum tunneling.
